preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the array N for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element A[i] in the array must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total length of all arrays across test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(A.count(x) > N // 2 for x in set(A)) else True
postconditions.description: If any element appears more than half the length of the array, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == N and all(len(set(stdout.split()[i:i+3])) == 3 for i in range(N-2))
postconditions.description: The output array must have N elements and no subarray of length greater than 2 is non-increasing or non-decreasing.
